title: fix(plugin-security)!: a delegated business-unit walk never starts at a unit outside the caller's organization
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the delegated-administration gate holds the root of every delegated business-unit walk to the same organization as its descendants, so the range a self-delegation's anchor is judged against holds units of the caller's organization only. Nothing is widened: no export, error code or status is added.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — a runtime authorization bound inside `@objectstack/plugin-security`; no authorable key, value or metadata type changes, and no `skills/**` or docs page teaches the self-delegation anchor range's organization bound.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:委派管理按业务单元圈定的范围,其起点(根单元)与下级单元同一条规则:只能是调用者所在组织的单元。
- 为什么改:ADR-0105 D6 红线 2 —— 一切业务单元机制只在一个组织内运作,没有跨组织的树;委派范围里的每个单元(含根)都属于调用者的组织。
- 风险与回滚:只动 plugin-security 的委派管理闸门;组织内范围里的锚点、不带锚点的职务代理照旧通过,拒绝的答复与范围外锚点一致。按先例 c1e08feb2 声明为收窄(BREAKING,patch 级):锚在本组织之外单元的自我委派从此被拒。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts` 的 `resolveSubtreeById`(根判定那一段);再看两个测试文件末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts -t "never starts at a unit outside"`,预期 `Tests  15 passed`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Rule** (ADR-0105 D6, red line 2: *"Every BU mechanism — `unit_and_subordinates` sharing, `adminScope` delegation, depth scopes — operates within one organization. There is no cross-org tree."*): a delegated business-unit walk never starts at a unit outside the caller's organization.

- `DelegatedAdminGate.resolveSubtreeById` reads the walk's root under the bound organization's own scoped context and applies to it the same row predicate the walk already applies to every descendant. A root that is not a unit of that organization covers nothing.
- Every subtree a self-delegation's anchor range is built from (ADR-0091 D3, rule 4b) therefore holds units of the caller's organization only. An anchor outside the range is refused with `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, the same answer whichever organization the unit belongs to.
- `resolveSubtree` (a scope's by-name anchor) keeps its answers: its root is already resolved inside the organization, so the new predicate holds for it by construction. It gains one by-id read per resolved scope.
- No refusal text, error code, schema or export changes.

## Tests

- `delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts`, new describe *a delegated business-unit walk never starts at a unit outside the caller's organization*, on a real `ObjectQL` engine and `SqlDriver` with the real `SecurityPlugin`, in `single`, `group` and `isolated` (5 tests per posture, 15 in all):
  - an unanchored holding's range is the delegator's member units of its own organization; an anchor at a unit of another organization gets the same answer as an anchor outside the range;
  - a holding anchored at a unit of another organization makes no unit an admitted anchor;
  - CONTROL: a holding anchored at a unit of the caller's organization keeps its subtree as the range;
  - the data door stores no delegation anchored at a unit of another organization, and stores one inside the range;
  - CONTROLS throughout: an in-organization anchor inside the range is admitted, and so is an unanchored delegation.
- `delegated-admin-gate.test.ts`, new describe on a double that scopes nothing, so the row predicate is the only thing standing: 3 tests, one of them a CONTROL, including an organization-less unit.
- The posture rig's `boot` takes optional extra catalog entries, so the new describe's delegatable position does not change what the other describes enumerate.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not added:** a second anchor check in the self-delegation rule. Once every root is held to the organization predicate it is redundant, and a refusal reason of its own would answer ids that are units of the caller's organization differently from other ids.
- **Untouched, as ordered:** the by-name root for a context that names no organization, with its docblocks and pins. The existing pins on the subtree staying inside one organization, with or without an organization on the context, hold unchanged.

## Verification

Readings at `3de01b6fb` unless stated. The final head `b731e114b` changes only the changeset (the narrowing declaration, its BREAKING paragraph and the ADR-0087 marker).

- Dogfood battery at `b731e114b`: lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`, `Test Files  438 passed | 3 skipped (441)`, `Tests  3622 passed | 41 skipped (3663)`, no failures.

<details><summary>Package suite and typecheck</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test`: `Test Files  249 passed (249)`, `Tests  5886 passed | 45 skipped (5931)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck`: exit 0 (`tsc` src and scripts, plus `check:test-typecheck` OK).
- These two ran at `cf5c2456c`. The commit after it changes only the changeset's declaration line.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one-time, nothing left in the tree)</summary>

- Mutation: the root predicate is removed on disk through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hits 1 → 0, blob `4cd4659e28e4` → `e0c1deb04f78`). The subject resolves through relative `src` imports, so no `dist` is in the path.
- With it removed, the two files report `Tests  11 failed | 242 passed (253)`: the 9 posture legs (3 per posture) and the 2 fake-engine pins that are not controls. Every CONTROL stayed green.
- Restored: the blob equals the one at `HEAD` (`4cd4659e28e4`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The same files then report `Tests  253 passed (253)`.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `3de01b6fb`: 66 commands. Each ran from the worktree, with its exit code captured before any pipe: 66 of 66 exit 0.
- `--ran` reconciliation: `66 derived, 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` (a derived zero: every line records its exit code).
- At `cf5c2456c`, the first sweep had `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n` refuse their prerequisite (exit 3, missing `dist`). After building the closure that `check:i18n` names, both measure green on the head re-run: 122 require entry points across 72 packages load, and 10 packages' bundles are in sync.
- Changeset gates on the final changeset: `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-empty-changeset` (all `--base origin/main`) exit 0, and so does `check:nul-bytes`.
- Every family CI runs is read from this PR's check-runs. None of them is re-run locally.

</details>
